policy: Only Git-tracked public or project-authored derived inputs may enter the packaged V28 runtime. Raw caches, credentials, full-text corpora, external-model-derived tables and uncertain-rights market exports are excluded.

sources.notes: The package contains compact numerical or categorical inputs, not downloaded articles, full parliamentary transcripts or API caches. The external-model-derived candidate-issue aggregate is registered separately under external_model_derived_candidate_issue_aggregate; this family's Apache-2.0 basis covers project authorship only.

sources.license_or_basis: No explicit license tag was published on the model card at audit time, so no redistribution grant is claimed for the model. The retained file is a compact numeric candidate-issue aggregate computed with that encoder; it embeds no model weight, no model architecture and no source sentence, and it is not itself a copy or adaptation of the weights. It is distributed on that basis, not on a licence from the model author, and the absence of a tag is disclosed rather than assumed permissive.
sources.attribution: Aggregate derived by this project using the public jhgan/ko-sroberta-nli encoder over official National Assembly proceedings.
sources.notes: Separated from project_authored_and_derived_tables because that family's basis is Apache-2.0 project authorship, which does not describe an external-model-derived artefact. Competition Article 9 asks that embedded AI be open weights and run independently: this encoder is open-weight and ran locally, and V28 does not run it at all. Removing this file is not cost-free - the full-removal diagnostic moved regional macro MAE from 2.613902987%p to 4.935929128%p and winner accuracy from 0.8 to 0.6 - so it is disclosed rather than dropped. See docs/AI_MODEL_SPEC.md and docs/FINAL_MODEL_V28_20260822.md.

sources.provider: National Assembly of the Republic of Korea, official proceedings
sources.license_or_basis: No grant is claimed from the provider. All three files are project-authored derivations of official proceedings and contain no verbatim excerpt: the 2025 rows replace each excerpt with its character count, and the two issue-match tables hold only the output of the project's own keyword matching. The collected 2025 rows that do carry excerpts stay in excluded_paths and are not redistributed, because the provider terms prohibit sharing the supplied information unchanged.
sources.attribution: National Assembly of the Republic of Korea and Election Forecast contributors
sources.notes: These are the derived inputs that let a clean checkout rebuild the 2025 forecast; without them it needs 154 MB of files this repository does not track. The 15th-22nd matches are the same rows as the archived copy, gzipped - 3.1 MB against 118.9 MB. Reproduction from the public tree covers everything downstream of the keyword matching and takes the matching itself as given. source_sha256 is retained per 2025 row so a holder of the official minutes can verify provenance without the text being redistributed. See docs/PRES_2025_INPUT_GUIDE.md.
